name: rogue-mods
description: Mods for Claude's interface from The Rogue Roadmap: themes, panels and other changes to how Claude looks and behaves. Each mod installs on its own.

plugins.name: rasenshuriken
plugins.description: Theme: a Rasenshuriken that decays into a simple Rasengan as the context window fills up. Dark and light modes.

plugins.name: sharingan
plugins.description: Theme: a Sharingan that gains tomoe as the context window fills up, until the Mangekyō marks the genjutsu of a degraded context. Kai compacts. Dark and light modes.

plugins.name: rogue-road
plugins.description: Theme: a hooded explorer walks the roadmap from dawn to dusk as the context window fills up, and stops to wait whenever Claude needs your input. Milestones, weather, companions, a logbook, ambient sound and a context ledger above the prompt; /make-camp compacts and brings a new dawn. Dark and light modes; Spanish, English or French.
